headline: The 5 best ProjectHuddle alternatives for agencies (2026)
standfirst: ProjectHuddle is now SureFeedback, same self-hosted WordPress plugin, new name. It's still a fine feedback tool. The gap is usually the hours a person spends finding mistakes. Five options. One is ours. One is staying put.

superflowHeadline: SureFeedback is a feedback plugin. Superflow is a QA tool + a team.
superflowBody: The team is AI agents, built from your QA checklist. They check every site change and pin what they find. Your team decides. Your client approves from a link.
superflowBestFor: agencies where a senior person still checks every site by hand.

entries.name: Atarim
entries.bestFor: WordPress agencies that want an AI review team, not just a comment box.
entries.standout: six AI agents (the InnerCircle) that scan a live page for design, UX, SEO, copy, and QA issues in seconds, plus Global, Project, and User memory context.
entries.limits: AI review is admin and team only; clients and guests never see it. AI use is metered by monthly credits and capped by tier. Priced per seat with active-project caps (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: AI actually checks the page and remembers project context across reviews, something SureFeedback doesn't do. SureFeedback runs on your own WordPress site under one flat license with no per-seat math.

entries.name: BugHerd
entries.bestFor: agencies that want feedback pinned right on the live page, no WordPress required.
entries.standout: element pins with browser, OS, and screen size attached; built-in kanban.
entries.limits: A person finds every issue, no AI. No memory concept; each project starts blank. Formal client approval flow: not yet verified. Pricing $50 / $80 / $150 per month, +$8 per member (July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: No WordPress install needed on your side, but it's per-member SaaS pricing against SureFeedback's one flat license for unlimited sites and users.

entries.name: Pastel
entries.bestFor: fast markup rounds without touching WordPress at all.
entries.standout: zero-install proxy canvas with a formal Finish Review approval flow on every plan, including Free.
entries.limits: Reviews the site through Pastel's proxy, not the page in place. PM-tool exports gated to the $119/mo Team plan. No memory concept (checked July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: No install and a built-in approval button, against SureFeedback's own-your-data WordPress plugin with its own page and project approval flow. Pastel shows a proxy of your site; SureFeedback runs natively on it.

entries.name: Markup.io
entries.bestFor: teams that want one flat price across websites, images, PDFs, and video.
entries.standout: flat $79 per month for unlimited users, plus an auto-screenshot audit trail via the Chrome extension.
entries.limits: Proxy and iFrame based; sites that block iFrames or require login can break. Internal or private comments the client can't see: not yet verified. No native two-way PM sync (checked July 2026).
entries.vsAnchor: Flat per-workspace pricing instead of SureFeedback's tiered licenses, but it's a proxy and iFrame review of your site, not a native plugin running on your own WordPress install.

stayHeading: The sixth option: stay on SureFeedback
stayBody: One flat license covers unlimited sites, mockups, and users, and the plugin runs on your own WordPress install, so you keep and own the data. Guests comment with just a name and email, and approve with one click. GPL licensed and 100% white label (verified July 2026).
stayLine: If you want a self-hosted, own-your-data WordPress feedback plugin with unlimited projects and clients, stay.

faq.question: Which is the best SureFeedback alternative?
faq.answer: Depends which criterion fails you. If it's the checking hours, Superflow, the only one where the answer is a team, not a tool.

faq.question: Is Superflow just SureFeedback with AI?
faq.answer: No. SureFeedback collects the feedback a person finds. Superflow's agents find the mistakes first, and a person makes every call.

faq.question: Can clients comment without an account?
faq.answer: On several, SureFeedback included, where guests comment with just a name and email. In Superflow the client's yes is a recorded approval, not a comment.

faq.question: What does switching cost?
faq.answer: An afternoon. One snippet, or one click on Webflow, WordPress, GTM. Open projects finish where they are.
